justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No RCTs comparing PCS vs non-PCS outcomes in pediatric PT.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS exam plus 2,000 hours pediatric PT experience; major career investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any pediatric PT caseload; broadly useful in children's hospitals, schools, and pediatric outpatient.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Pediatric PT billed under standard codes; PCS does not unlock new billing codes or payer categories.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in children's hospital and pediatric outpatient settings; moderate employer demand.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Families may prefer credentialed pediatric specialists.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Some pediatric cash-pay markets exist (intensive programs, autism, sports performance for kids) but most pediatric PT runs through insurance, EI, or schools.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Board specialty supports premium pricing in intensive or concierge pediatric programs.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: PCS is uncommon — clear differentiator in any pediatric market.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Pediatric practices scale with credentialed staff, though insurance reimbursement caps margins.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Parents seek 'specialists' for their kids but don't search for PCS by name; referrer-driven demand.
justifications.business.efficiency: Residency or 2,000-hour pathway plus exam — slow and expensive.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ABPTS board specialty — top-tier credential for pediatric faculty hiring and promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: PCS holders are heavily represented in pediatric PT research and APTA Academy leadership.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly aligns with required pediatric DPT content and lifespan courses.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Pediatric rehab evidence is solid for CP and developmental disorders; mixed for others.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently listed as preferred or required for pediatric faculty positions.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Long pathway, but residency option provides academic mentorship value alongside the credential.
